name: Exhaustive UCB ensemble surrogate
tagline: BANANAS-style 7-MLP path-encoding ensemble (with target z-norm and L2) scores all ~15K NAS-Bench-201 architectures each step under linearly decaying UCB.
init_recovers: Greedy ensemble-mean argmax at $\beta=0$ (matches BANANAS's posterior mean)
diff_from_baseline: Replaces BANANAS' 500-random subsample + greedy mean with exhaustive scoring of every valid architecture under a UCB acquisition whose $\beta$ linearly decays; also adds 7-member ensemble (vs 5), z-normalized targets, and L2 regularization on MLPs. No evolution like REA.

name: EI BANANAS + mutation-biased pool
tagline: BANANAS path-MLP ensemble with closed-form Expected Improvement, a candidate pool whose mutation share grows with progress, decaying $\sigma$ exploration bonus, and a final greedy local refinement around the best arch.

key_hyperparams.name: mutation ratio
key_hyperparams.role: fraction of pool drawn from top-5 mutations

init_recovers: BANANAS at mutation_ratio=0 and explore weight=0
diff_from_baseline: Switches BANANAS' argmax-mean to closed-form EI, hybridizes the random candidate pool with REA-style mutations of the elite, and ends with explicit greedy local search — neither vanilla random search, REA, nor BANANAS does this combination.

name: Matérn-5/2 GP + EI over full space
tagline: Replaces BANANAS' MLP ensemble with a Matérn-5/2 Gaussian process on path encodings (length-scale chosen by marginal-likelihood grid) and uses tanh-approximated Normal-CDF EI over every valid arch.

key_hyperparams.name: EI fallback β
key_hyperparams.role: UCB tradeoff when EI saturates at 0

init_recovers: Random search during the warm-up phase; UCB(β=1) when EI saturates
diff_from_baseline: Drops BANANAS' MLP ensemble entirely for a Matérn-5/2 GP with marginal-likelihood length-scale selection and EI acquisition; differs from REA (no evolutionary population) and from random search (model-based scoring of every architecture).

name: Hamming kernel + ridge residual + final-pick
tagline: Hybrid surrogate: Hamming-distance kernel smoother as prior plus a 7-member bootstrapped ridge ensemble on path+edge+op-count features fits the residual; UCB+trust+novelty acquisition with local elite bias and a separate conservative final-pick.
diff_from_baseline: Differs from BANANAS by combining a Hamming-kernel prior with a residual ridge ensemble (no MLPs), uses an explicit final architecture chosen by a separate posterior — possibly never queried — and adds REA-flavored local exploitation around top-3 elites, which random search and REA do not have.

name: EI BANANAS over full space
tagline: Standard 5-member BANANAS MLP ensemble but Expected Improvement (with $\xi=0.01$) is computed over every valid architecture and blended with mean exploitation as progress grows.

key_hyperparams.name: exploit_weight
key_hyperparams.role: linear blend EI ↔ mean as budget consumes

diff_from_baseline: Differs from BANANAS by replacing the 500-random pool with full-space EI scoring and convex-blending EI with $\mu$ as budget runs out; not REA (no mutation/population) and not random search.
